svg.title: Six-class one versus rest ROC curves
svg.desc: Classical logistic and fixed quantum random forest on same 203 training cases in fivefold case out of fold evaluation. Curves use TI-RADS category probabilities and are exploratory.
svg.text: TI-RADS one-vs-rest ROC • 203 cases • five case-stratified folds • exploratory training-only
Predicted-label recall for TI-RADS 3 was 0/10 in quantum RF; ROC curves show ranking across thresholds.
